name: nationdex
description: The Project Nationdex 2026, also known as Nationdex 2.0, is a modern revival from one of the oldest dex bots in existence, which is named Nationdex.bot!

scripts.build:binary: bun run build && bun run bundle:prep && bun run build && bun build dist/index.js --compile --outfile binaries/nationdex-bot-linux-x64 && tar -czf binaries/nationdex-bot-linux-x64.tar.gz -C binaries nationdex-bot-linux-x64 && rm -f binaries/nationdex-bot-linux-x64
scripts.build:binary:arm64: bun run build && bun run bundle:prep && bun run build && bun build dist/index.js --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile binaries/nationdex-bot-linux-arm64 && tar -czf binaries/nationdex-bot-linux-arm64.tar.gz -C binaries nationdex-bot-linux-arm64 && rm -f binaries/nationdex-bot-linux-arm64
scripts.build:binary:windows-x64: bun run build && bun run bundle:prep && bun run build && bun build dist/index.js --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile binaries/nationdex-bot-windows-x64.exe && zip -9 -j binaries/nationdex-bot-windows-x64.zip binaries/nationdex-bot-windows-x64.exe && rm -f binaries/nationdex-bot-windows-x64.exe
scripts.build:binary:darwin-arm64: bun run build && bun run bundle:prep && bun run build && bun build dist/index.js --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile binaries/nationdex-bot-darwin-arm64 && tar -czf binaries/nationdex-bot-darwin-arm64.tar.gz -C binaries nationdex-bot-darwin-arm64 && rm -f binaries/nationdex-bot-darwin-arm64
scripts.build:binary:darwin-x64: bun run build && bun run bundle:prep && bun run build && bun build dist/index.js --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile binaries/nationdex-bot-darwin-x64 && tar -czf binaries/nationdex-bot-darwin-x64.tar.gz -C binaries nationdex-bot-darwin-x64 && rm -f binaries/nationdex-bot-darwin-x64

author: NationDex Team (https://github.com/nationdex)
